description: Land Title Settlement Department - Walana, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad Map No. 530031 (24/0602)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including details of ownership, property boundaries, encumbrances, and legal status of various land plots in the Walana area. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including land registrations, property ownership, and land titles as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
